missing: the FPU's fp32 read (K-30) is a truncation, i.e. a coherent bias over long dot products; rounding the operand to TF32 nearest-even first (on the host for weights, on device by int bit ops, or SFPU in DEST before a pack) makes the read exact and unbiased (DS41-31)

the SFPU is one unit shared by the TRISC threads: with half-sync DEST, SFPU work issued on the math thread beside pack-thread SFPU work (exp_packthread style) corrupts results (rel 2-400); keep a kernel's SFPU steps on one thread
